title: Northgate Retail Bank Credit Policy: Credit Line Increases on Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards
content:
**Tests.** A credit line increase on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, whether requested by the cardmember or offered on review, requires all of the following.

1. The account is in active status.
2. At least the card's required number of full calendar months have passed since the account's opened date. Full months are counted from the opened date to the same day of a later month (the last day of the month when that day does not exist), and the increase is allowed on that day.
3. At least the card's required number of full calendar months have passed since the last credit line change date when there is one, counted the same way.
4. The on-time streak reaches the card's required number of on-time statements. The streak counts consecutive statements backward from the most recent statement whose payment due date has passed, a statement counting when the payments credited on or after its statement date and on or before its due date add up to at least its minimum payment due (a statement with a minimum payment due of 0.00 counts as on time).

The account status, opened date and last change date are read from the account record.

**Size.** The new credit line is at most the current credit line plus the card's largest single increase percent of it, at most the card's highest line reachable through increases, and within the combined credit line limit across the customer's accounts; it is rounded down to a multiple of USD 100.00.

**Outcome of a failed test.** A request that fails any test is declined and the credit line is unchanged. Credit lines are never decreased at the cardmember's request through customer care.

## Month boundary (hypothetical opened dates; 6 full months required)

| Opened date | First day an increase is allowed | Day before it |
|---|---|---|
| 15 January | 15 July | 14 July: not allowed |
| 31 August | the last day of February | the day before: not allowed |

## Upper bound in figures (hypothetical card: largest single increase 35 percent, highest reachable line USD 10000.00)

| Current line | Current line plus 35 percent of it | Upper bound | Rounded down to a multiple of USD 100.00 |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 2000.00 | USD 2700.00 | USD 2700.00 | USD 2700.00 |
| USD 2150.00 | USD 2902.50 | USD 2902.50 | USD 2900.00 |
| USD 8000.00 | USD 10800.00 | USD 10000.00 | USD 10000.00 |
